paper.title_en: Perfect state transfer on trees in the normalized Laplacian quantum walk
paper.abstract_en: We prove that, in the normalized-Laplacian model, perfect state transfer between two vertices of a tree can only happen if they are at distance at most $2$. We show that a conjecture of Coutinho and Baptista, stating that the only trees admitting perfect state transfer are $K_2$ and $P_3$, is true when the two vertices are at odd distance. We then construct infinite families of trees admitting perfect state transfer, disproving their conjecture in the general case.
